title: No description under 200 numbers matches the model as well as the model matches itself
sub: The network reads 10 random numbers and names the position of the second largest. Each point is one attempt to describe it. Lower is better. Shaded corner: at most 200 numbers and at or below the dashed line.

points.label: 2nd-largest with a phantom zero
points.detail: Hand-written rule: track the top two values, with an extra 0 before the sequence. 4 numbers, none fitted.

points.label: + 3 special cases
points.detail: The 4-number rule plus three special cases (late near-tie, one positive input, no positive input) whose threshold and positions were fitted to the model's choices. 12 numbers.

points.label: 374 weights, 4 digits
points.detail: The model's own weights: smallest entries set to 0, the other 374 rounded to 4 significant digits. Nothing retrained.

points.label: 374 weights, 3 digits
points.detail: The model's own weights: smallest entries set to 0, the other 374 rounded to 3 significant digits. Nothing retrained.

points.label: 382 weights, 3 digits
points.detail: The model's own weights: smallest entries set to 0, the other 382 rounded to 3 significant digits. Nothing retrained.

points.label: 386 weights, 3 digits
points.detail: The model's own weights: smallest entries set to 0, the other 386 rounded to 3 significant digits. Nothing retrained.

points.label: all 400 free weights, 3 digits
points.detail: All of the model's weights, with the 32 numbers fixed by rescaling symmetries removed, rounded to 3 significant digits. Nothing retrained. This is the best of 10 equivalent forms (adding one vector to every output row); the others give 98.4% to 98.9%.

points.label: 374 weights, 0-4 digits each
points.detail: The model's own weights, each given the fewest digits (0 = removed) that keep agreement. Nothing retrained.

points.label: 364 weights
points.detail: Pruned to 364 nonzero weights while retraining to copy the model's outputs, then rounded to 3 digits. All 364 numbers are fitted.

points.label: 2nd-largest of rescaled inputs
points.detail: 2nd-largest after giving each position its own fitted gain (10 constants).

points.label: 2nd-largest of mixed inputs
points.detail: 2nd-largest of a fitted linear mix of all 10 inputs (100 constants).

points.label: shared scorer per position
points.detail: One small fitted network scores each position from its value, its rank among the top three and where the maximum sits; the highest score wins (175 constants).

points.label: linear tie-breaker per position pattern
points.detail: For each pattern of where the top three values sit, a fitted linear rule decides between 2nd and 3rd (about 9,000 constants).

points.label: piecewise-linear rule per position pattern
points.detail: For each pattern of where the top three values sit, a fitted piecewise-linear rule on the top three values and running maxima (63,270 constants).

points.label: fitted MLP
points.detail: A 3-layer MLP (143,873 weights) trained to copy the model's choice; not fully trained.

points.label: linear model per rank pattern
points.detail: For each pattern of where the top three values sit, a fitted linear map from inputs to outputs (87,100 constants).

points.label: lookup table
points.detail: Lookup table on (positions of the top three, binned gaps, signs): each of 398,000 cells set to the model's majority choice on training samples, scored on new inputs.
